text:
liz: heads-up: customer using Cloudflare Workers got runtime error from our SDK: `ReferenceError: process is not defined`. they import `import { createClient } from 'redwood'` in an ESM worker.

rahul: that usually means bundler picked our CJS entry. we need a worker-specific ESM entrypoint and exports map so tools prefer it.

kate: +1. also ensure we don't call `Buffer` or `process.env` in the worker build. prefer `globalThis.crypto` and Uint8Array.

liz: minimal repro attached in their note: stack points into `dist/index.cjs` requiring `crypto`.

rahul: plan: add `dist/index.worker.mjs` with guarded runtime checks, add "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs" in exports, and ship a `declare module 'redwood/worker'` in our d.ts to keep types working.

kate: for crypto shim use: `const webcrypto = globalThis?.crypto ?? (typeof require !== 'undefined' ? require('crypto').webcrypto : undefined);` wrap the require path in `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` so bundlers can tree-shake it.

infra-bot: CI alert: bundle:cloudflare job failed on PR #439 -> `Could not resolve "crypto" in node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs`. Assigning to @rahul.

liz: action items: @rahul open small PR with worker entry + exports change; @kate add d.ts augmentation and example under `devex/samples/workers/`; I'll add a Miniflare integration test in `integration/cloudflare/` to CI. aim for quick patch.

rahul: will send PR today, will include a tiny sample `wrangler` config in the sample folder.

liz: thanks team. this should cut down edge support tickets. :thumbsup:
